body.name: Certified numerical padding \(\Delta_n^{\mathrm{num}}\)
body.construction: On \(\kappa_n=0\), let \(\Delta_n^{\mathrm{enc}}\) be the sum of the nonnegative radii obtained by propagating the deterministic coordinate error \(2^{-p_n-1}\) through the certified recurrence, let \(\Delta_n^{\mathrm{arith}}\) be the sum of the nonnegative outward radii for retained-projector and pseudoinverse enclosure, matrix-sign and residual-inverse steps, gate classification, normal and chi-square quantiles, scalar calibration, interval wrapping, and final endpoint rounding, and set \(\Delta_n^{\mathrm{num}}=\Delta_n^{\mathrm{enc}}+\Delta_n^{\mathrm{arith}}\).  On \(\kappa_n=1\), the handle is not run; extend every summand of \(\Delta_n^{\mathrm{enc}}\) and \(\Delta_n^{\mathrm{arith}}\) by zero and set \(\Delta_n^{\mathrm{num}}=M_0\).
